purpose: ERC-4337 Paymaster economics model for Arc. Computes gas cost (gasPerUop × gasPriceGwei × 1e-9 × ethPriceUsd), sponsorship break-even, and per-UOp user-facing cost. Comparison: Arc user pays / Arc+Paymaster / Ethereum L1. No ETH bootstrap required on Arc (USDC-as-gas).
